solution_summary: Korea Credit Data built its Databricks implementation around Delta Lake, Lakeflow Connect, Databricks Data + AI Platform, Unity Catalog. Korea Credit Data — a fintech company that’s always been concerned with helping small-to-medium enterprises (SMEs) optimize financial data management, enhance decision-making and support their sustainable business growth — developed the data-driven Cashnote app to achieve all of these initiatives for their valued customers. Better yet, the app allowed business owners to overcome a variety of common obstacles, includi. Delta Lake stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning. Lakeflow Connect ingests source data from operational systems into governed lakehouse tables. Databricks Data + AI Platform provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables with ACID guarantees for downstream analytics and machine learning.

solution_components.name: Lakeflow Connect
solution_components.role: Ingests source data from operational systems into governed lakehouse tables.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workflows in this deployment.

solution_components.name: Unity Catalog
solution_components.role: Applies centralized governance, lineage, auditing, and access control across shared data assets.

solution_components.name: Databricks Lakeflow
solution_components.role: Schedules and orchestrates recurring data pipelines and transformations.

solution_components.name: Auto Loader
solution_components.role: Incrementally ingests new files or events into the lakehouse as data arrives.

data_flow: Source data and events are ingested through managed connectors, files, or streaming feeds into databricks, curated in Delta Lake tables, processed with Databricks compute and orchestration services, and exposed to downstream analytics and users. It connects with Amazon SQS, RDS, APIs.
business_outcome: With Databricks, KCD has significantly reduced pipeline management costs. Previously, they executed 700,000 transaction pipeline-related queries per day in RDS, leading to high I/O costs that amounted to tens of millions of won per month.
metrics: 90%+ Reduction in management costs through pipeline optimization strategies
70%+ Reduction in additional cluster maintenance costs with Unity Catalog
50%+ Reduction in cluster execution costs through optimization
KCD’s Cashnote app — used by 1.4 million business owners — provides insights into credit card sales, credit score management and financial benefits.
“Queries that joined around 30 billion data sources to create this aggregated data were highly complex,” explained Sangyoung Park, Data Engineer at KCD.
Since a transaction pipeline runs every 20 minutes, there was no longer a need for data ingestion to be constant.
